title: Good quality, great design, love the handle, but capacity is small
text: Good quality, great design, love the handle, but capacity is small. Beautiful, but a bit heavy, hopefully handle will hold up over time.  However, love that the glass serves as the cover.  I keep it on my bedside.  Just know that it does not hold much water so look at the specs carefully before deciding to buy this particular set IF you are looking for something with bigger capacity.  That being said, I have had other sets and this one by far is the easiest to handle and nicest looking.  Good quality
